references.text: A psalm that encourages giving to the poor, echoing Jesus' call to the rich young man.
An encouragement to share with the poor, parallel to Jesus' instructions.
A parallel event where Jesus gives similar advice to another rich young man.
An encouragement to sell what one owns and give to the poor, in line with Jesus' words to the rich young man.
The first Christians sold their possessions and shared with those in need, reflecting Jesus' instructions.
An example of early Christians selling their belongings to support the poor, in the spirit of Jesus' command.
An encouragement to do good deeds, such as giving to the poor, as a way to store up treasures in heaven.
